_note: Estimated Penske-style pricing for POC. Based on publicly available Penske rate ranges as of 2024. Actual rates vary by location, season, and availability.

one_way_fee_usd.description: Applied when drop-off location differs from pick-up location.

basic_liability.name: Basic Liability Protection
basic_liability.description: Covers third-party bodily injury and property damage up to state minimums. Does not cover the rental truck itself.

limited_damage_waiver.name: Limited Damage Waiver (LDW)
limited_damage_waiver.description: Reduces your financial liability for physical damage to the rental truck down to a $500 deductible.

full_damage_waiver.name: Full Damage Waiver (FDW)
full_damage_waiver.description: Reduces liability for physical damage to the rental truck to $0 deductible. Recommended for long-distance moves.

cargo_protection_basic.name: Cargo Protection - Basic
cargo_protection_basic.description: Covers cargo inside the truck up to $15,000 in case of accident or truck rollover.

cargo_protection_premium.name: Cargo Protection - Premium
cargo_protection_premium.description: Covers cargo inside the truck up to $35,000 in case of accident, theft, or truck rollover.

fuel_cost_reference.note: All Penske trucks use diesel. Price is an estimate; actual price varies by region and date.
